bars.label: Compounds recovered, per document ground truth
Share of what was drawn that anyone catalogued

headline: Whole documents, unedited. Precision is not quoted here: only a seventh of what these documents draw is catalogued by anyone, so a structure matching nothing is usually a real molecule nobody listed rather than a misreading.
footer: Stages 1+2+3 on all 149 committed PDFs, 1,900 pages, zero pipeline failures. Recall is per document against that document's own ground truth. Precision is NOT reportable on this corpus and is deliberately not quoted: the denominator would be every structure drawn, and only a sixth of those are catalogued.

armsNote: All eight arms on the same 760 compounds — the largest set every arm covers. Strict is the string as emitted, which is what you get pasting it into a database. Graded allows a tautomer, a charge or a salt to differ. Phantom is the share of predictions carrying a stray disconnected fragment welded on beside an otherwise correct molecule.
